Auth.signInDescription: Sign in to Starforge (one login for app and CMS when you have CMS access).
Auth.welcomeNoteGuest: Welcome — password, magic link, or email code. Stay signed in when you trust this device. After sign-in, set up authenticator 2FA under Account security.
Auth.welcomeNoteHome: Welcome — use the panel for password, magic link, or email code. Helpers cover forgot password, forgot login email, stay signed in, and 2FA after you sign in.

Layout.offlineAdminBanner: Site is offline for visitors. You can browse because you are an app admin.
